body:
This is a map that me, swizzy and jozz made over time! (server provided by Subzero)

Any suggestions for improvements will be appreciated.
Download:https://www.mediafire.com/?iw48o5v9wqtbtov
YML: http://pastebin.com/GiD8Lb5G

SPAWN KIT: http://gyazo.com/3e8fe9e6a84d8579fcbac1ab49ddaf8c

Sorry for the image links, We didnt use imgur xP

Changelog

Version 0.1
- Released map to public

Version 0.2
- Added another middle "island" below the original one. 
- Spawn kit created
- Better lighting 
- Added spectator spawn

Version 0.3
- Added YML
- Many block fixes
- Added World Download!

Version 0.4
- Removed bottom two monuments for each team
- Added beacon and diamond spot 
- Added TNT 
- Extra chest in middle with one special item
- Added better defense in front of the diamond spot ^^
- More block fixes :/
- Removed water where the old monuments were.
